# Security verdict, #333 round 1 at 50c675ac58318d9303a062b890ec649d47806cea: pass

The diff is a one-line condition change in crates/tmux/src/lib.rs, plus a test and docs. CI 5/5 SUCCESS at this head.

## Ownership still decides
The changed line runs only after the unchanged ownership check:
- a pane with a local tap uses the path this daemon recorded;
- otherwise the listed marker must exist and equal `expected_tap_sink(pane)`, or the pane is refused ("no owned tap" / "foreign tap") and skipped.

## A pane released without sending can't be a foreign tap
The new branch needs the pane listed with NO pipe and NO marker. A pane with no marker can only get past the ownership check through the local branch, meaning this daemon started that tap and recorded its path. `release_tap` then removes only this daemon's own entry from `self.taps` and unlinks that recorded sink path (F262: a path it created and recorded). It sends no tmux command, so it can't close anyone's pipe.

Pre-existing, unchanged: an owned pane that someone else has re-piped reads as attached and is sent the detach, as before this PR.

## No unsafe tmux error text
The change adds no logging. The only error text in this path is the existing `release_tap` "could not remove tap sink" message (the sink path and an io error) and the round-2 detach error string. Both go to the result and the local stderr only, never into argv, an option, a path or a seat message.

The change can only remove sends, never add one. No secrets, lockfile or .npmrc changes.
